projects.name: AI Email Drafting Automation (Sales)
projects.objective: Reduce sales follow-up email drafting time by 70% using Claude 3.5 + Kommo integration

design_brief.architecture_approach: Kommo webhook + Make.com + Claude API → Draft generation → Human review → Send
design_brief.interfaces_contracts: Kommo trigger (new lead, follow-up needed) → Make flow → Claude draft → Return to Kommo for review
failure_modes: Claude API timeout → queue and retry
Kommo sync failure → alert and manual fallback
Draft quality poor → human rejection, fallback to manual
design_brief.rollback_plan: Disable Make flow → disable Kommo webhook → manual email drafting resumes
design_brief.tests_verification_plan: Unit tests for draft quality, integration test with staging Kommo, manual QA with 5 sample emails

tasks.title: Audit sales email templates and response patterns
Build Make.com workflow (Kommo trigger → Claude → Kommo draft)
QA: Manual test with 5 sample scenarios

artifacts.purpose: Claude prompt template for email drafting
Make.com workflow definition (Kommo → Claude → email draft)

verification.expected_output: Draft email in Kommo, human-approved, sent to lead

rollback_commands: Disable Make workflow: go to Make.com → disable email drafting flow
Disable Kommo webhook: go to Kommo → Settings → Webhooks → disable EmailDraftRequest
post_deploy_checks: Verify Make flow is running (check logs)
Test with 1 sample lead (draft should appear in 2-5 sec)

risks.risk: Claude API quota exceeded or rate-limited
risks.mitigation: Implement queue + retry logic, monitor API usage daily
Maintain Kommo API version lock, monitor changelog
Prompt iteration, manual review before send, fallback to human drafting

next_steps: Iterate on prompt based on QA feedback
Monitor draft quality and Kommo sync

projects.name: Marketing Dashboard (MassDwell Sales Funnel)
projects.objective: Real-time visibility into MassDwell lead funnel: awareness → interest → engagement → lead → MQL → SQL

design_brief.architecture_approach: Looker Studio connected to Kommo + Google Sheets ETL → Dashboard
design_brief.interfaces_contracts: Kommo API (read leads, deals, stages) → Google Sheets (denormalized view) → Looker Studio (visual dashboard)
failure_modes: Kommo API down → dashboard stale (show last known data + timestamp)
Google Sheets quota exceeded → alert and pause refresh
Looker Studio connection broken → alert team
design_brief.rollback_plan: Revert Google Sheets ETL scripts → restore from backup
design_brief.tests_verification_plan: Compare Kommo totals vs dashboard totals (should match), manual visual inspection

verification.expected_output: Dashboard shows lead counts by stage, matches Kommo

risks.risk: Kommo data completeness (some leads may not have proper stage)
risks.mitigation: Data quality audit before launch, show 'unknown' stage explicitly

change_control.impact_assessment: If Make flow breaks, sales team falls back to manual drafting (no revenue impact)
change_control.rollback_plan: Disable Make flow and Kommo webhook

build_queue.request_summary: Prototype AI email drafting workflow (Kommo + Make + Claude)
Build MassDwell sales funnel dashboard (Looker Studio)
Hardening: Add encryption to sensitive gateway configs

tech_debt.title: Kommo sync is polling-based (inefficient)
tech_debt.description: Current sync checks Kommo every 5 min. Should use webhooks for real-time updates. Causes API quota bloat.

tech_debt.title: Agent state is stored in JSON (not versioned)
tech_debt.description: Agent state is in flat JSON files. Should use versioned, immutable state store (e.g., event sourcing). Current approach limits auditability.

tech_debt.title: Monitoring is manual (no automated dashboards)
tech_debt.description: No real-time dashboard for system health. Requires manual log checking. Should implement Grafana + Prometheus.
